caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest or cabinet with a heavy decorative design. The chest is rendered primarily in light to medium brown tones, with darker shades used to accentuate edges and carved details. The front face is detailed with a large, central geometric motif featuring a star-shaped pattern enclosing the inscription "7h9 EM" within a polygon. Both sides of the front panel are adorned with vertical, spindle-like columns, and there is a row of small, round, dark knobs or beads toward the bottom. The sides of the chest are decorated with symmetrical, scrollwork patterns in reddish and brown hues, with some diamond-shaped carvings visible. The chest rests on four dark round ball feet, and is topped with a slightly overhanging, beveled, and ornately moulded lid. The chest is centered on a plain, slightly yellowed paper background with a hand-drawn rectangular frame lining the image area.
title: Cabinet for Storage
